title: Thesis: Preservation of Pairwise Correlation in Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: A Master's thesis repository comparing deep-learning and statistical generative models (CTAB-GAN+, TVAE, TabSyn, TabDDPM, GaussianCopula) for their ability to preserve inter-feature correlations in continuous tabular data. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are run as baseline/comparison generators alongside metadata objects to evaluate correlation preservation.
